transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’ve ruined everything for my family and don’t deserve to be here anymore, no matter what anyone tells me. It just feels like I've become a complete burden to everyone who cares about me.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of feeling this low or hopeless at any point in your life before this current episode?

No, I've never experienced anything like this before in my life. Before my heart procedure and having to give up my driving and volunteer work about a year and a half ago, I never felt this kind of deep hopelessness, guilt, or darkness.

Have you ever felt so overwhelmed by these thoughts of worthlessness that you have started to believe things that others tell you are not true, or have you noticed any changes in your perception of reality?

Yes, I am completely convinced that God is punishing my family with sickness because of my past selfishness, even though my wife and pastor swear it isn't true. And sometimes when I'm sitting alone, I hear this low, stern voice behind me whispering that I'm just a burden and deserve to pay for what I've done.
Do these voices and beliefs persist even when you are feeling relatively calm, or do they seem to intensify specifically when your mood is at its absolute lowest?

They only seem to happen when I am trapped in this deep, heavy darkness. I never heard those punishing voices or had these awful thoughts back when I was healthy, driving, and volunteering. They only started and have stayed with me since I fell into this dark spell after my heart procedure.

These features strongly support the previous candidate of a major depressive episode with psychotic symptoms. The symptoms are linked temporally to a medical event, but the current clinical picture remains consistent with F32.3.
